eval: (() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; if (!game.debug) throw new Error('golden-frame needs the dev hooks (a dev server, or a build with ?debug=1)'); const { ctx, state } = game; const canvas = ctx.renderer.domElement; for (const element of document.body.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (element !== canvas && !element.contains(canvas)) element.style.visibility = 'hidden'; } game.debug.pauseLoop(); state.paused = true; const spawn = state.spawn; ctx.systems.flight.resetTo({ x: spawn.x, y: spawn.y, z: spawn.z, heading: spawn.heading }); ctx.systems.sky.setDayTime(ctx.util.dayTimeForSunElevation(ctx.CONFIG.START_SUN_ELEVATION_DEG, true), { transition: 0 }); state.time.elapsed = 30; ctx.uniforms.time.value = 30; game.debug.stepFrames(30); return JSON.stringify({ paused: true, spawn: { x: Math.round(spawn.x), y: Math.round(spawn.y), z: Math.round(spawn.z), heading: Math.round(spawn.heading) } }); })()
